findings.detail: Original activity relied on static X-Requested-With. r4 uses random 16-byte session-bound CSRF checked under session mutex plus exact trusted Origin. Tests reject missing/null/untrusted/suffix/path origins, wrong token and another session token. Host and X-Forwarded headers are not trusted.

reviewed_invariants.result: Credential publication invalidates sessions under authorization mutex. Idle/absolute use monotonic age with backward-time rejection. Reads and GET csrfToken never renew interaction. Capacity eviction precedes insertion, ordered by interaction then issuance.

Fingerprint includes digest and existing LWW record identity including decimal sequence. Rebuild publishes only after successful durable commit. Local change, replicated change and config rebuild apply the same binding.

Config and metadata share BEGIN IMMEDIATE and Store mutex; row/meta/commit failure rolls back. Node observer rejects failed mutation without publishing. Real disk tests exercise config/meta failure and reopen consistency.

Origin requires http/https with bounded authority and delimiter/wildcard rejection. Exact direct origins use local IPs/loopback and listener port; bounded explicit allowed_origins support DNS/proxy. No Host/X-Forwarded trust.
Authenticated session GET returns no-store CSRF without interaction. Activity requires trusted Origin and current session CSRF. Expired sessions fail before renewal.
Owned queued handler rechecks live gate at dispatch, retaining T04 Pending/unknown-outcome ownership.
Visible interaction sends bounded activity. Polling does not renew. Stop clears runtime/CSRF; generation checks reject delayed old runtime token responses.

limitations: Independent source/evidence review; no reviewer rerun.
Host real HTTP/Store tests use deterministic clock/network seams; no device or physical action qualification.
Partitioned nodes cannot revoke unseen credentials; offline repeated login is not prevented.
T08 CSRF verdict covers new activity endpoint, not all pre-existing mutations scheduled for later contracts.
Current Store contains parallel T05 edits; this verdict is anchored to frozen r4.
